answer: The strongest lever is simple: cap per-account emission and put the surplus into a pool earned only by non-duplicate work, because sable only stays cheap while duplicating content caps out because the pool rewards novelty, not volume. Concretely, glacier is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any velvet approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
